result.title: Stop hardcoding a governed-intake producer revision as policy
result.body:
<!-- governed-work-unit-key: sha256:c68ed0e2f1588e7ec3b5d1b587282ebb4596f09a0af463fa5b35a4f2b45c6bb5 -->

## Work type
Task

## What happened or what is needed?
Code still names a specific governed-intake producer revision as policy after the published release has moved on. Live admission of spencer-shadley/.github is revision 23. The work-spine publication binding still records revision 22 as assessment authority, and the GitHub MCP worker triage adapter still tells callers that revision 22 and revision 23 follow different rules. Those callers need the currently published producer revision, resolved at run time, and one behaviour.

## Initial priority guess
P3

## Why this initial priority?
Current fleet-law projection ignores the stale binding while publication is ready, so triage is not failing closed on it. The adapter text can still send a writer down a dual path the published contract no longer has. The harm is repeated and misleading, and it is not a crash or a blocked fleet path.

## Relevant details

That tip's task form is generated from GovernedIntakeBodyV1 version 23. `admitCurrentGovernedIntakeRelease()` on 2026-10-10 returned revision 23, producer commit 4601851a0630d5ba9f3c42bffc66b794f234b079, release commit 4c3c99e49ef71273aa6d1969ac17614a90e9970a, payload sha256:d09609ceeed4cdaa3eb9e3162ed0e18f2b57ebe6f5f7febe77e886bfe280774d, prefix metadata:triage-v, label metadata:triage-v23.

Advisory locations, not acceptance criteria:
- tools/work-spine/work-spine-contract.v1.json publication block, including preparationAssessmentBinding.producerRevision 22, producerCommit 763aa95282da19e923b6f5834c6f1a51a9ec3bd5, payloadDigest sha256:2007e37b0d8ca0f5c5a2cd91641ac84f9dea9b0ec26f1b66481c722cc50fb46a, and codeSourceCommit a747169767d2327bda7db240cf478fc8bc7079fe. publication.state is still candidate_until_verified_producer_adopts_namespace. tools/work-spine/fleet-law-projection.ts applies that binding only when publication is not ready. Publication is ready, so the pin is not the live gate. It is still policy data naming revision 22.
- tools/github-mcp-worker/src/triage-assessment-adapter.ts instructional strings around the schema description, the binding mismatch hint, and the two disposition and checklist reason hints. They say revision 22 retains qualified-receipt, decomposition-label, and substrate rules, and that revision 23 drops or replaces them. The published contract is one revision.

code#7930 owns the second-opinion behaviour change on the adapter file. This issue owns the numbered-revision policy pins, including the work-spine binding and the decomposition-label and substrate sentences, which #7930 does not cover. code#7625 owns worker deployment for the semantic revision and does not name the preparationAssessmentBinding pin.

Repository responsibility: who-owns.ts wrote .ops/receipts/ownership/unpin-producer-revision-policy.json with disposition split-by-change, recommended owner unresolved, confidence medium. Ranked .github, agent-cockpit, agent-review, fleet-control-plane, fleet-host-runtime, and fleet-observatory, and every one Lost because its charter does not claim this change. spencer-shadley/code is missing-charter, so the resolver could not return it as single-owner. The bytes that must change are Code tools. The public .github repository owns producer template bytes and must not change for this issue. agent-orchestrator is not the owner: this is not loop-kernel behaviour.

Direction question: could this issue materially change direction? No. It follows the standing rule that consumers use the latest published producer revision and do not pin one. It does not retire, migrate, or reshape an earlier accepted outcome.

## Durable fix and acceptance
A reader of the work-spine publication binding and of the GitHub MCP worker triage adapter follows the currently published producer revision, resolved at run time, and is not asked to choose between two numbered revisions. The fleet-law projection and the triage worker are the consumers. Fixture data and generated producer bytes stay unchanged. Acceptance is that ready publication no longer presents an older numbered revision as assessment authority, and the adapter's operator-facing text no longer states that one numbered revision retains a rule another numbered revision drops.

## Human-decision state
No human decision required. The standing direction is to use the latest published producer revision and not to pin one.
